data.title: 毒蛇 · 都会霓虹街头的露脐自拍
data.description: 繁华方舟商业街霓虹闪烁的十字路口，人潮退去的深夜。毒蛇身着贴身的粉色超短露脐上衣与超短热裤，纤细柔韧的腰肢与肚脐在霓虹光影中分外惹眼。她单手举着智能手机向前俯身自拍，波浪卷发滑落在胸口，另一只手在脸侧比出可爱的猫爪手势，嘴角挂着只向你绽放的甜蜜微笑。
data.action: posing close in front of camera holding smartphone, cropped pink top showing midriff and navel, making cute cat-paw gesture, pink wavy hair cascading, radiant sweet smile
data.location: bustling cyberpunk shopping street intersection with glowing holographic displays
data.lighting: vibrant magenta and cyan holographic billboard reflections
data.mood: trendy cyber-dating romance, addictively sweet girlfriend appeal
data.promptProse: Leaning close to the camera in a vibrant neon city square, Viper poses in a cropped pink top and denim shorts. She makes a playful cat-paw gesture with one hand as her emerald eyes sparkle with sweet, dangerous devotion.
data.animaCaption: Viper posing in a pink crop top on a neon city street with a cute cat-paw gesture.
